title: He Ran Through The Dark To Save The Girl He Once Bullied . . . (highlight)
caption:
He ran through the dark to save the girl he once bullied. 😢 A Silent Voice (Koe no Katachi), the night of the fireworks. Full recap is on our page 👉 link in the comments

#asilentvoice #anime #animemovie #animerecap #fyp

segments.say: Shoya Ishida is holding the hand of the deaf girl he once bullied, and she is hanging over the *edge*.
It is the night of the summer *fireworks*, and everything feels so peaceful.
Only minutes ago, he asked Shoko when her *birthday* was.
She said it had already passed. Next year, he promised, they would celebrate *together*.
But Shoko leaves early, and Shoya stays behind with the *crowd*.
Later he goes to her dark, quiet flat to pick up his *camera*.
Then he looks out, and freezes. Shoko is standing on the edge of the *balcony*.
Something is terribly wrong, and he *runs*.
He dives, and catches her hand at the very last *second*.
Now she hangs over the drop, and his arm is the only thing holding *her*.

segments.text: God, please give me one more chance.

segments.say: He swears he will never run away from anything *again*.
From tomorrow, he will look at every face, and listen to every *voice*.
He pulls with everything he has. And in one second, it all *changes*.
The full story is on our page.
